FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: Manufacturing PMI Beat Supports USD Resilience Against JPY
tldr_points: ISM manufacturing PMI beat expectations at 55.5, signaling resilient US economic activity.
Easing Iran tensions and lower oil prices foster a risk-on environment supportive of USD/JPY.
Technically, USD/JPY is consolidating just below the MA20 at 157.93, primed for a bullish breakout.
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY consolidates below MA20. Resilient PMI and risk-on sentiment support a bullish rebound toward 158.50.
FX.comment: Resilient US manufacturing PMI and positive risk sentiment support a bullish bias as the pair consolidates above key support near 157.50.
